ReQuests

Estimated reading: 1 minute 701 views

– Coming Soon

Welcome to ReQuests, an integral part of our comprehensive MLS platform. Here, agents can efficiently search and filter client requests, whether originating from other estate agents or direct clients from the Public Portal. 

Key Features:

  • Search and Filter: Quickly navigate through a vast array of client demands to find those matching your listings.

  • Integration with MLS: As part of the MLS platform, ReQuests enhances your workflow by offering a seamless, unified experience.

Structure:

LeadBoard is divided into two main sections:

  • Agent ReQuests: Tailored for estate agents to access requests from other agents.

  • Client ReQuests: Designed for direct client requests, allowing agents to find and connect with potential clients from the Propertylist.es Public Portal.

See more details in the sections following.

Dive into ReQuests to maximise your real estate opportunities and streamline your client interactions.
